registerLayout: fm1_crash_t: magic, count, vec, pc, rets, emu, dbg, sp, psr, icfg, uptime_ms, etm[4], early, core
targetChange: The simulator raises SoC IRQ 1 with DBG bit 4 at 1200 and 9200 ms. The unchanged linked guest runs its exception handler, saves the .noinit record, waits through both four-second deadlines, selects safe mode, scans PLAY and requests all three chip resets.
oracle: The host RAM/SPI LCD fixture re-renders each complete diagnostic, safe, retry and post-crash frame using the recorded target crash structure. Every match compares all 57,600 pixels after normalizing the display exporters to the same RGB565 expansion. PNGs are captured from the target, including the real per-model PCs.
